scope: Owner EOF while a protected registration, renewal or cancellation awaits the peer, and removal of libcoap's OSCORE client send hold

standard.name: IETF Observing Resources in CoAP
standard.summary: A client may deregister explicitly with a GET carrying the observation token and Observe value 1

source_identity.kind: exact source-file SHA-256; no source commit association asserted

defects.observed: Owner EOF while the protected registration awaited the peer sent no cancellation
defects.cause: Exit cleanup cancelled only an established observation, although the sent registration may already have created a peer observer

defects.observed: Owner EOF while a Max-Age renewal awaited the peer sent no cancellation; a renewal timeout's terminal event arrived about five seconds late; a cancel command behind an unanswered renewal returned timeout
defects.cause: libcoap sets its OSCORE client hold on every coap_send because a client recipient context never leaves its initial replay state, and clears the hold only when a response arrives. The next PDU construction blocked in coap_client_delay_first for up to five seconds, past custody's 25 ms termination signal on exit

assertions: Patch 0008 removes the OSCORE hold from coap_send; the worker keeps one exchange at a time and its own deadlines
Owner EOF during a pending registration abandons it as a possible peer observer and sends exactly one original-token cancellation
Owner EOF during a pending renewal sends exactly one original-token cancellation
Owner EOF during a pending cancellation sends no second cancellation
Each case reaps the worker with owner-loss status and the peer count is checked for 1,000 ms after EOF
Exit cleanup ignores exchange callbacks, so no report or reply is produced after owner loss
A renewal-timeout observation reaches its terminal event within 3,500 ms of the initial report

A cancellation admitted behind an unanswered renewal is confirmed by the peer's response with result null within the 1,000 ms command deadline; this corrects the timeout recorded by native-worker-renewal-cancel-v1.json
On macOS the harness fails its pending owner-loss cancellation assertion against the preceding helper and against the updated worker built with the seven-patch SDK
